description: Systems and Components: where Languages are defined and used, the Components each imports, and the Transformations between Languages. Extends Kernel.

axioms.about: Every Component is either nested in another or beside the root of a System
axioms.formula: all c in Component. (some c.system and no c.parent) or (no c.system and some c.parent)

axioms.about: A System's root is one of its top-level Components
axioms.formula: all s in System. s.root in s.components

axioms.about: No Component is nested in itself, eventually
axioms.formula: all c in Component. not c in c.^parent

axioms.about: A Component uses only Languages in its scope: its own and its parents', and those of the Components it imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, l in c.uses. l.component in c.*parent or l.component in c.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Language extends only Languages in the scope of its Component
axioms.formula: all l in Language, x in l.extends. x.component in l.component.*parent or x.component in l.component.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Transformation's source is a Language its holder uses
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation. t.source in t.holder.uses

axioms.about: A Transformation's target is a Language its holder uses
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation. t.target in t.holder.uses

axioms.about: A Transformation's context is of its target's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, e in t.context. e.language in t.target.*extends

axioms.about: A Relationship mapping requires both end Entities mapped
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping, e in m.source.ends. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings. n.source == e.entity

axioms.about: A Component imports only its siblings, or what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, k in c.importedComponents. k != c and (k in c.parent.components or k in c.system.components or k in c.^parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: A Component imports a Transformation only from its siblings, or from what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, t in c.importedTransformations. t.holder != c and (t.holder in c.parent.components or t.holder in c.system.components or t in c.^parent.importedTransformations or t.holder in c.*parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: Entity mapping sources are in the source Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all m in EntityMapping. m.source.language in m.transformation.source.*extends

axioms.about: Entity mapping targets are in the target Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all m in EntityMapping, x in m.targets. x.language in m.transformation.target.*extends

axioms.about: Relationship mapping sources are in the source Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping. m.source.language in m.transformation.source.*extends

axioms.about: Relationship mapping targets are in the target Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping, x in m.targets. x.language in m.transformation.target.*extends

axioms.about: Target Relationships join images of the source Relationship's ends
axioms.formula: all m in RelationshipMapping, r in m.targets, e in r.ends. some n in m.transformation.entityMappings, s in m.source.ends. n.source == s.entity and e.entity in n.targets
